description: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants who rated various criteria for a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system. The horizontal axis represents the number of participants, ranging from 0 to 6, while the vertical axis lists the criteria evaluated. The criteria include "Relevant FCs," "FC Summary," "Relevance Explanation," "Clarity and Simplicity," "Overall Summary," "Filters," and "Veracity Explanation." The "Relevant FCs" criterion received the highest number of participants, with 6 individuals rating it, followed by "FC Summary" with 5 participants.
